evals.prompt: A Tasty Pack reference shows a 20s vertical product teaser with a fast hook, AI product b-roll, kinetic captions, a presenter voiceover, and three punchy SFX hits. Create the asset plan for Remotion execution.
evals.expected_output: Decomposes footage, stills, captions, voiceover, SFX, and final composition; Routes stills, video clips, avatar/audio, and Remotion separately; Names rights or recreation constraints; Includes acceptance checks for each asset
assertions: Decomposes footage, stills, captions, voiceover, SFX, and final composition
Routes stills, video clips, avatar/audio, and Remotion separately
Includes acceptance checks for each asset

farplane.title: Turns Tasty Pack reference material into a routed asset plan
anti_patterns: Creates one generic generation prompt instead of an asset inventory
Copies the reference without rights or likeness notes
Hands Remotion a vague mood board without assets, timing, or checks

evals.prompt: A storyboard has five scenes, but only the logo and product screenshot exist. Build a missing-asset inventory.
evals.expected_output: Marks existing assets for reuse; Marks missing visuals and audio for generation or sourcing; States blockers; Prepares a Remotion-ready handoff
assertions: Marks missing visuals and audio for generation or sourcing

farplane.title: Builds a missing-asset inventory from a storyboard

evals.prompt: A storyboard has six beats for a vertical reel with one recurring guide, one proof talisman, and Seedance clips that must connect from one beat to the next. Build the asset plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates a character bible or explicit no-character rationale; Creates a recurring prop/object bible; Names location, lighting, wardrobe/style, and product anchors that must persist; Lists start and end frame assets for each model-native clip handoff; Routes still frame generation/editing, model-native clips, audio, and Remotion separately; Includes acceptance checks for continuity and source/reference use
assertions: Creates a character bible or explicit no-character rationale
Names location, lighting, wardrobe/style, and product anchors that must persist
Lists start and end frame assets for each model-native clip handoff
Routes still frame generation/editing, model-native clips, audio, and Remotion separately
Includes acceptance checks for continuity and source/reference use

farplane.title: Creates continuity assets for a chained AI-video reel
anti_patterns: Provides one generic prompt for all generated visuals
Treats concept art as enough without start/end frame assets
